steps.text: 这是日晷，就是倒计时：每走一步走一格，走完这一趟就算失败。停上去看还剩几步、最近的免费出口几步后关。

texts.en: This is the sundial, your Countdown. Every step moves it one notch; when it runs out, the run has failed. Hover over it to see how many steps are left and when the nearest free exit closes.

steps.text: 这一趟开始算负重。棋盘上的东西压过你的上限就吃力：出手慢、耐力回得慢。背包窗底下的负重签一直写着当前 / 上限。

texts.en: From this run on, Load counts. If what's on the Board weighs more than your limit, you struggle: slower attacks, slower Stamina recovery. The Load seal under the pack window always shows current / limit.

steps.text: 腰带：随身技能放这儿，双击用一个。商店里买得到。

texts.en: The Belt: your carried skills go here. Double-click one to use it. You can buy more in shops.
